caption: The drawing depicts a single piece of light-colored fabric, possibly a handkerchief or scarf, draped to form a triangular or diamond-like shape with folds and creases visible. The fabric has a repeating pattern of small circular motifs in yellow, brown, and purple distributed across its surface, with greater density along the draped edges. The border of the fabric features a larger, repeating pattern of circular medallions in yellow and purple with detailed embellishments around their edges, creating a band that follows the lower edge of the hanging fabric. The object is depicted against an off-white or light beige background, and a name, likely the artist's signature, is written in the bottom right corner.
title: Handkerchief
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
